fieldData.name: Banyan Flats: A Practical Look at Dallas's Oak Cliff Apartments
fieldData.meta-description: Banyan Flats is a 289-unit apartment community in Dallas's Oak Cliff. Floor plans, rent ranges, amenities, and honest location context in one place.
fieldData.post-summary: Banyan Flats is a 289-unit apartment community at 2020 N Beckley Ave in Dallas's Oak Cliff neighborhood, opened in March 2024. Developed by Banyan Residential, it offers studio through three-bedroom apartments with both market-rate and income-restricted units.
